sehemu: Part II: Members of Parliament, Constituencies and Election of Members
jina: Persons holding Government office to cease service upon becoming candidates
maudhui: Where any person holding office in the service of the Government decides - (a) to become a candidate for election as President or for any other office under this Constitution; or (b) to contest for leadership at any level in a political party contrary to the conditions of his employment, that person shall be deemed to have ceased to hold office in the Government service from the date on which he becomes a candidate for election or contests for leadership in a political party.
